def: Ajin, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine

occurrences.text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
